name: Chimera
description: A mythological fire-breathing monster of disparate parts; on Theros, magical fusions of creatures' life essences.

timeline.summary: In an Akroan tale, Keranos creates a deadly beast to test Renata; she slays the first chimera of Theros effortlessly.
timeline.quote: When Renata slayed this lion-ram-dragon creation effortlessly (the first chimera of Theros)

relations.note: Suspected and, per an Akroan tale, said to have created chimeras.
relations.quote: Keranos created another combination of deadlier beasts to challenge her.

relations.quote: She slayed that beast too, and all the other countless Keranos' creations.
